I'm interested in adding a Lexer for [NVIDIA PTX](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution/#instructions) for a project I'm working on. I see that there's some documentation [here](https://pygments.org/docs/lexerdevelopment/) for adding a new Lexer. Would this be okay to add to the Pygments library?

    """
    For NVIDIA PTX assembly code.

    .. versionadded:: 2.11
    """
    name = 'PTX'
    aliases = ['ptx']
    filenames = ['*.ptx']
    mimetypes = ['text/x-ptx']
    url = 'https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution'

    #: optional Comment or Whitespace
    string = r'"[^"]*?"'
    identifier = r'[a-zA-Z_$][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*'
    number = r'(?:0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+|0[fF][0-9a-fA-F]+|\d*\.?\d+(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?)'
    register = r'%(?:[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*|rd\d+|f\d+|r\d+|p\d+)'

    tokens = {
        'root': [
            include('whitespace'),
            
            # Labels
            (identifier + r':', Name.Label),
            
            # Directives
            (r'\.' + identifier, Name.Attribute, 'directive-args'),
            
            # Instructions
            (identifier, Name.Function, 'instruction-args'),
            
            (r'[\r\n]+', Text)
        ],
        'directive-args': [
            (identifier, Name.Constant),
            (string, String),
            (number, Number),
            (register, Name.Variable),
            (r'[\r\n]+', Whitespace, '#pop'),
            (r'//.*?\n', Comment.Single, '#pop'),
            (r'/\*.*?\*/', Comment.Multiline),
            (r'[<>{}\[\](),.]', Punctuation),
            include('whitespace')
        ],
        'instruction-args': [
            (register, Name.Variable),
            (number, Number),
            (r'\[', Punctuation, 'memory-operand'),
            (r'[\r\n]+', Whitespace, '#pop'),
            (r'//.*?\n', Comment.Single, '#pop'),
            (r'/\*.*?\*/', Comment.Multiline),
            (r'[<>{}\[\](),.]', Punctuation),
            include('whitespace')
        ],
        'memory-operand': [
            (register, Name.Variable),
            (number, Number),
            (r'\+', Operator),
            (r'\]', Punctuation, '#pop'),
            include('whitespace')
        ],
        'whitespace': [
            (r'\s+', Whitespace),
            (r'//.*?\n', Comment.Single),
            (r'/\*.*?\*/', Comment.Multiline)
        ]
    }

    def analyse_text(text):
        """Check for PTX-specific directives."""
        if re.search(r'^\.(version|target|address_size)', text, re.M):
            return 0.8
        elif re.search(r'^\.(reg|param|local|shared|const)', text, re.M):
            return 0.5

    # Common PTX modifiers
    type_qualifiers = r'(?:\.(?:u(?:8|16|32|64)|s(?:8|16|32|64)|f(?:16|32|64)))'

    volatile_qualifier = r'(?:\.volatile)'
    cache_qualifier = r'(?:\.(?:ca|cg|cs|lu|cv))'
    scope_qualifier = r'(?:\.(?:cta|gl|sys))'
    rounding_mode = r'(?:\.(?:rn|rz|rm|rp))'
    
    # Combine all qualifiers
    qualifiers = r'(?:' + r'|'.join([
        type_qualifiers, space_qualifiers, vector_qualifiers,
        volatile_qualifier, cache_qualifier, scope_qualifier,
        rounding_mode
    ]) + r')'
